Hi, I’m Aaron. These are my working notes.
Much of these notes/writings are written for my own consumption, i.e. evergreen notes.
They began as a digital garden built with Quartz⁠. They have since become my working notebooks. You can find out more about me at the apex domain.⁠. This layout is credited to Andy Matuschak.
I also work quite a bit these days, so notes might appear unfinished (that’s the whole point.)
Here are a few things that I like:

Wittgenstein, Deleuze and Camus
determinism
hermeneutics
functionalism
Michel Foucault’s The Archaeology of Knowledge
interpretability megalist
high-performance inference engines
dimension-3 topology
algebraic geometry
homeomorphism
Sets

:wave: you can also reach out via twitter or email, I always love meeting new people!

gpg --locate-keys contact@aarnphm.xyz
